reply.label: Unreplied messages
reply.description: A lead wrote and nobody has replied
reply.automation: Send the first reply with prices and free slots

how.first: Read their last message on the right
how.second: Answer with prices and two free slots
how.third: Book the visit if they pick one

bookedVisit.label: Booked a visit
bookedVisit.effect: Appointment form opens · lead moves to Follow-up

follow.label: Lead follow-ups
follow.automation: Send a friendly check-in on WhatsApp

how.first: Check what they were interested in
how.second: Call or WhatsApp with a friendly nudge
how.third: Book, set a new follow-up or close the lead

claim.label: Leads open to claim
claim.description: The owner has been idle past the hold period

how.second: Claim it if you can take it
how.third: Otherwise leave it for the team

claimIt.label: Claim it
claimIt.effect: You become the owner · {{owner}} stays involved

failed.label: Messages not delivered
failed.description: The provider could not deliver a message
failed.automation: Retry on SMS, then flag for a call

confirm.label: Confirm visits
confirm.description: A visit in the next 48 hours has no confirmation
confirm.automation: Send the reminder and confirm when they reply Yes

how.second: Call if there is no reply by evening
how.third: Move the slot if they cannot come

arrive.label: Arrived or no-show
arrive.description: 15 minutes past the start and not checked in

how.second: Mark Checked in when they arrive

noShow.label: No show
noShow.effect: Appointment → No show · a rebook task follows

rebook.label: Rebook no-shows
rebook.automation: Offer the next two free slots on WhatsApp

how.first: Call or WhatsApp with two free slots
how.third: Close if they are not coming back

rebooked.label: Rebooked
rebooked.effect: Appointment form opens with the same service

feedback.label: Collect feedback
feedback.automation: Send the feedback form and close on 4–5★

how.second: Ask for a Google review on 4–5★

happy.label: Happy · 4–5★
happy.effect: Sends the Google review link · opens the review log

logCheckIn.label: Log check-in
logCheckIn.effect: How it is now · what they followed · next plan

aftercare.label: Aftercare calls
aftercare.description: A treatment asked for a follow-up call
aftercare.automation: Send the aftercare check-in on WhatsApp and log the reply

how.first: Call and ask how the skin feels
how.third: Log a check-in with the answer

logCheckIn.label: Log check-in
logCheckIn.effect: How it feels · what they followed · next plan

how.third: Offer a review visit or credit if needed

nextvisit.label: Next visit not set
nextvisit.description: A visit was completed but no follow-up date or next booking exists
nextvisit.automation: Suggest two slots on WhatsApp and set the follow-up when they pick one

how.second: Offer two slots for the next visit
how.third: Set a follow-up date if they are not ready

setFollowUpDate.label: Set follow-up date
setFollowUpDate.effect: Sets the follow-up to 2 weeks from today

noreply.label: Regulars gone quiet
noreply.description: A regular or package patient has not booked for 30+ days and the periodic reminders got no reply

how.first: Look at the package and last visit
how.second: Call once, then send a come-back offer
how.third: Close if they are not coming back

callNow.label: Call now
callNow.effect: Opens the patient file · log the call there

sendOffer.label: Send offer
sendOffer.effect: Sends a come-back offer on WhatsApp · snoozes a week

how.third: Schedule the next step if needed

payment.label: Payment due
payment.description: A bill has a balance due

recall.label: Recall
recall.description: A patient is due back for a review
